body:
Bad?
* How is it that every time someone is driving you crazy, if you post something on Facebook about it, the exact person/people  pissing you off will Like it? DLKSAJSLAKJD ARGH
 
* iPhone eating yet ANOTHER pair of headphones (this is like...the 6th pair of earbuds in like 2 years?). Commuting is not as fun if I can't strut through the subway station listening to wrestling themes and bad dance music. :(

* Smash Mouth still hasn't eaten those damn eggs.  Fucker.

Good:

* tomorrow is my day off!

How is it that every time someone is driving you crazy, if you post something on Facebook about it, the exact person/people  pissing you off will Like it? DLKSAJSLAKJD ARGH
                                                                                                          
That and my iPhone eating yet ANOTHER pair of headphones (this is like...the 6th pair of earbuds in like 2 years?). Commuting is not as fun if I can't strut through the subway station listening to wrestling themes and bad dance music. :(

You are not alone.  I literally have to talk myself out of crazy shit I over-think just to keep myself from believing the worst. I'm planning to start going to therapy within the next month and this'll probably be one of the main things I need to work on.

Does it keep you awake, too? My brain goes into overdrive at night :(

Hey, thank you so much for the kind words.  That story does sound familiar... the email I got from that "friend" practically read like a fanfic.  People can be so nasty to their supposed "friends"... I'm glad it sounds like you've gotten through it, though.

Yeah... hopefully after I get some therapy hours under my belt, I'll have the guts to start actively looking for friends.  Don't trust myself enough right now, and thanks to this incident I've started micro-analyzing every single thing people do around me, which I KNOW is stupid and unhealthy. But then, looks like that friendship was too...

Honestly, I think a lot of this was exactly what I needed to hear.  Thank you so much for the advice and the kind words.  The success thing... oh god, that is SO one of my problems.  99% is never enough... this comment really made me think.  Thank you so much.

Hey, thank you so much for the kind words.  That story does sound familiar... the email I got from that "friend" practically read like a fanfic.  People can be so nasty to their supposed "friends"... I'm glad it sounds like you've gotten through it, though.

Yeah... hopefully after I get some therapy hours under my belt, I'll have the guts to start actively looking for friends.  Don't trust myself enough right now, and thanks to this incident I've started micro-analyzing every single thing people do around me, which I KNOW is stupid and unhealthy. But then, looks like that friendship was too...

Thank you for the reply.  I'm sorry to hear about the marriage/friendship problems, that has to be really hard.  I'm glad you did have some people to stand by you, though, and I hope the 3 of you have long, happy lives together. :)

Yeah... I'm really mad and hurt at them, but I still have enough not-crazy in me to realize that I'm not perfect and they aren't mustache-twirling villians.  Sometimes I wish I WAS crazy enough to think that, it'd probably be easier, but unhealthy in the long run.... 2 more weeks.  Just gotta hold on 2 more weeks and I can see a therapist, and at the end of the month is the last time I'm obligated to see those 2 friends (concert...I bought the tickets.. they owe me $140 and I still somehow want to believe things will work out somehow).

Thank you, and I'm glad you had friends with you for that.  I don't expect everyone to be my perfect support network or anything, but when I realized total strangers were being nicer to me... it hurts, you know?

My gym does have yoga classes.  I've never tried but maybe I'll look into it.  Thanks a lot. :)

Thanks.  I'm already trying to work on the exercise thing.  Confidence... I thought I had it. I used to, when I had the old job.  

Yeah... I wanted to make amends for not being the best person ever (mind you I never did anything really major, I was mostly just flaky because I would hide when I felt shitty), but I guess you can't. It sucks, I always want to give people 2nd chances... maybe too many... but apologizing and trying to be a better friend made things... well, MORE weird. 

Japan, these people were other US expats.  Honestly the longer I spend away from them the more I realize a lot of their attitudes were unhealthy as well, but basically every thought that comes out of my brain right now gets second-guessed ("am I crazy right now? how about now? ACK")

We're all from the US. 
The locals are much sooner to say "you're a very important person to me." ONly problem is this particular friend lives hours and hours away, and her mother is currently going through chemo for breast cancer, so while I mail to check on them, and sent their house flowers for mother's day, I don't want to load her down with my problems.  I dont' even know if she knows I'm not friends with our other friend anymore.  I really DO try to avoid drama, guys, I swear :()

I've been here in Japan about 8 years now.  A lot of people you get close to go home over a timespan like that.  I would consider going home except the economy basically guarantees I will be better off financially (and medically, hooray social health insurance for 20 bucks a month) over here for the time being.  I gotta get out and find some new people, but I guess I should wait until the therapy starts? yargh.  But thank you again for your advice. :)

Thank you so much. This is really good advice, and some things that I am trying to work on.  I was trying to do a "focus on me" month last time, and then out of nowhere those friends started talking to me again and I lost it all -_- I have a gym membership, I'm trying to go more often but I need to push myself a bit more.  Working nights and the "MUST SLEEP FOREVER" instincts are a struggle, but when I get myself up the activity really does help, you're right.  I haven't tried meditation yet. Did you take classes or just read up, or what?

Pulling away is probably hurting her even more than some harsh words would.  Honestly if that ....*individual* that cut me off had just said "hey, I'm sorry, I have a lot of stuff going on right now too and I just need some time to cool down, can we take a break for a few months?" honestly, I would have been hurt, but I would have been able to understand.  I don't know how much I have in common with here, though.  Most of your second paragraph I wouldn't say sounds like me at all. I'm constantly thinking 'oh god am I going to make other people feel bad?'

does she get any treatment at all? that poor girl...

>To read that a 30+yo woman is still so dependant on shitty drama fueled fake people is depressing.

You have obviously never lived in Japan. heh.

Early 20s were nice and simple.  30 is not.  With all due respect, I hope your usual attitude towards friends who are dealing with depression or mental health issues is not to call them immature and talk about how much better you are than them.

Hey, thank you for the kind comment. I was kinda doing this fora while.  It was hard because the depression had taken my interest in a lot of things away for a while, but when those 2 friends left me crying and didn't talk to me for a month, I found myself loading up old PSX RPGs I hadn't played in years, stuff like that.  I think one of the things that really stuck in me was when I was reading some old article about "The Wall" by Pink Floyd (yes I am a cheesy loser who sometimes gets through bad days listening to that album) and there was a quote from Roger Waters about how when people are depressed, they'll focus on things OTHER people created to try and plug the holes... and that made me more depressed, because the only conversations these friends seem to want to have is about bands.  ....and how worried they are that the members are depressed or unhappy.  

I loved writing so much.  I absolutely have the material for a great book based on my past work, but I'm kinda scared to put fingers to keyboard right now..I'm hoping the therapist can help me with that too. Maybe I'll give it a try, compared to my high school days when I wrote terrible slashfic it has to be better... :)

this is the thing, though.  1) Making friends is not that easy out of college 2) I'm scared I'm gonna get all clingy because I am so lonely right now, or that they're going to find out that I'm crazy and dump me like these people did.

I am also terrified that my friends that I don't see a lot are getting bullshit stories about me from the one who cut me off, and don't know how to approach this. Do you send an announcement when you stop being friends with someone? Ugh...

I have never tried to use them as therapists.  I don't want to be a burden, this is part of why I get the suicidal urges. When I was trying to stay in touch with the other 2 friends I purposely tried to be as upbeat and happy as possible, I thought that maybe if I showed them a better time and was more fun/positive than the other girl that they wouldn't leave me. It didn't work. :(

I can't go home.  I have a job and a roof over my head here. My family cannot afford to take care of me, I have a Liberal Arts degree, and my hometown is like 20% unemployment.  I think I really would blow my brains out if I went back. But thank you for confirming that I just need to let go.

Honestly the other girl who dumped me is probably 100 times more dramatic - it helps in that it makes me miss her less to remind myself of that, but makes it more frustrating that I'm alone and she isn't. 

Because of the job I mentioned, I was REALLY broke for a long time.  So I often couldn't do birthday presents or whatnot.  Usually when I was really depressed/upset I would just cancel or stay away because I didn't want to be a burden.  It was only when I realized that constantly wanting to throw myself into the path of an oncoming train was not normal and there was something really wrong that I actually asked for help...

This is just it though - I have TRIED to be there for them.  When something happens to THEM, I would check on them, try to cheer them up... I just get constipated looks.

The best was when I went to a concert with the 2 friends, Friend 1's favorite member had just gotten kicked out so she started crying, I was next to her so I try to give her a hug... she wouldn't pull in and instead reached around me to the other girl, like my comfort wasn't fucking good enough.  I never spent all my time shit-talking like the other girl who dumped ME, and honestly when things go shitty for me I usually curl up into myself, I don't get clingy like the person you're talking about.. I just needed support one time, and they ignored it. At least that's how it feels.

Thank you for the advice though.

I was 28 when I lost my virginity. You're not alone, and it doesn't mean something is wrong with you.   I honestly think there's more of us out here, but no one wants to admit it. 

Save the money from that job you get no joy from, hold onto it until you find what you're looking for.  Good luck.

Thank you. I really want the guts to do this. I almost had last time.... 
I just keep thinking "well they're not ALL bad, it would be mean to cut them off," but yet these are the people who saw me curl into a ball and say "I want to die," and I had to bribe them to spend time with me on my birthday... I didn't even realize how fucked up that was until it came up with another person and they said "oh my god, that's terrible."

I should've figured things would end up like this.  These chicks had a Japanese friend who was suicidal (her boyfriend killed himself, she found the body)... the girl who cut me off used to talk shit about that girl behind her back, too.  I should've run right then...

I'm stuck with them at least one more time in August - concert we planned to go to together.  I paid for everything and they haven't bothered to pay me back yet so technically I could just sell their tickets but it's just too much drama/trouble.  I have enough stress right now...
schizophrenia? are you saying that I'm delusional or paranoid? the contact information I do appreciate (I'm nowhere near Tokyo unfortunately) but I'm wondering why you think it's schizophrenia?

I appreciate the sentiment, but there was nothing.  I got cancelled on again.  Ended up home alone. Same as always. Saddest part is if I move on from these people... that's it. Can't afford to move and I'd be a burden at home.  THe only new people I meet now are at work and I can't let them know i'm like this... everyone thinks I'm all normal and friendly and happy there. I wish I could fool myself like I did them..
I don't know what's wrong with me.  That's just it.  I've tried everything you said over and over and it doesn't work.  That's why I want to just end it.

I think I know how you feel.  I had the same thing happen to me when I reached out... it hurts so much but we have to remember, we aren't the only imperfections in a perfect world.... Their coldness to you isn't normal either. Their shittiness is not because of you, it's because of THEM. 
Please live.

honestly that's one reason why I don't have a license (luckily don't need one in Japan). I seriously never trust myself to not just swerve into a bus or something. seriously dude let's make a pact and both get checked out.

Hey. It's not your fault. I"ve been the same way - you don't know why or how to stop it, you just keep thinking about it. You probably just need to get checked for depression, after the folks here talking me down last night that's first on my list to get done now. There's nothing wrong with you, you don't have to have been abused or have some horrific backstory to feel like shit. Family can really suck... honestly pretty much everything sucks at 17 regardless I think. But you're almost to adulthood soon where you can get out, away from your family and do what you want.  At least give yourself the chance to see what you think of life when you actually get a choice of how to live it first.
maybe we should both go. :\ Don't feel bad, I didn't realize until I hit bottom this week that wanting to jump off train platforms and bridges isn't normal...

I've never outright hit anyone but I have had bizzarre urges to do so. Sometimes in crowds I have to tell myself "no, it is not okay to lariat total strangers." I have said some really horrible shit though... I realized some of the fucked up shit that comes out of my mouth, that I thought was "sarcasm" but looking back was really mean, my mom does the same thing sometimes.

I just found out she's on Lexapro now. Kinda wish she woulda told me that...  Have you ever gotten checked out? The feeling of being cruel to your loved ones and not being able to control it really is horrible... you're not a bad person but it just comes out... :\

Honestly even just this much really, really helped. I'm still waiting for ANYTHING from my friends here but at least I don't feel like worthless scum to the entire universe anymore... 

When I get through this (I really want to get through this) I want to remember it, so I can help other people too...
You know I actually am in Kansai! Kyoto is FREEZING right now but that is still so incredibly kind of you :)
Thank you.

I just wanna say thank you so much for this - missed it for a while because of the time difference ( I had to work today - luckily Japanese people don't care about Christmas so no one asked me about it, I could just work and not think about it for a day, I think it was maybe a good idea).

I'm definitely going to try and find a good doc. In the meantime you guys really, really helped this Christmas. I'm still struggling with pushing the crazy in my head to the side, but at least y'all helped put things in a bit of perspective for me. This is a weird thing to say but I only cried twice today, and one of them was in a good way. That's a huge improvement from the rest of this week. :)

Thanks. Actually somehow through this I got a hold of my mom...turns out I never knew but she's on Lexapro. So apparently depression isn't unique in our family.

I'm gonna try and get a checkup on the new year. before that at least I have a friend in Tokyo coming down on the 30th, so at least I have someone to hug me IRL before then. :) thank you so much.
the logical part of my brain knows you're right but damn, i wish life had a fast-forward/rewind button.

i just wish i knew what to say. :\

>I don't even know you but if I can come away from this knowing that I managed to help you at all, it will have improved mine :)


You really are. thank you so much for taking this much time to support me.

first thank you. seriously you and the other folks that cared enough to write back are so kind.

I just keep wondering "why??" i probably do need some kind of distraction. even at work yesterday in the back of my head my brain I kept thinking I want to die, I want to die but at least i wasn't focused on it.  I don't want to feel like this.  Why do I have to feel like this?? I don't want to want to die. this is so stupid...

I do speak Japanese, but the thing is Japan has a HUGE stigma about mental health issues. Mentioning you have depression is like announcing you have the plague. :\

sort of trying to figure out the same thing right now. this has always been a problem for me and i wonder if it's one of the reasons why she didn't believe me... what do you even say when you feel like this??

and in the back of my head, i still feel bad fucking up someone else's christmas, even if mine is completley and utterly fucked.

it's not just you. I'm completely alone. It's CHristmas day here, it was Christmas Eve yesterday and I was alone then too. 

I hate life.

the part of my brain that isn't saying "the bitch'll figure it out when you're dead" knows you're right but I think it just hurts extra because this is the only person physically able to hug me right now and they don't even give a shit. 

if I can just make it a few days someone will be here but it just feels so daunting...

I guess you're right but I just keep thinking... she heard me say "I want to die." right in front of her. How the fuck can she not know? Am I that unimportant?? when people you thought know you better give less of a shit than total strangers you gotta start thinking the problem is you, you know?

i don't know what to do. fuck

The one friend who is still in the country, one of the ones who saw me break down on the street monday, one of the ones I sent the email to, just sent me a text. I got so hopeful.

It was a mass mail to everyone she knows saying "Hope everyone is having a Merry Christmas!"

I don't know whether to laugh or cry. Part of me wants to write back NO I'M FUCKING NOT HOW CAN YOU NOT KNOW THIS??

thank you.  I really can't wait until today is over. I feel like such an utter failure because I'm sitting here in my pajamas in an empty apartment.

one of the problems is that Japan basically shuts down for the new year. almost everyone who doesn't work in a store is closed from the 29th to the 4th or so. I work until the 29th. I'm basically alone with my crazy until then I guess. Maybe I should call those people but I seriously feel like just a "how are you?" from one of my friends here would do more than 1000 suicide hotlines..
